text: The realm remembers the father, not yet the son.
The first trials are passed; the old veterans have begun to watch.
The name Zhu carries weight again in council and camp.
Officers who served the father now speak of the son in the same breath.
The realm no longer says 'Zhu Jun's son'. It says Zhu Hao.
[[b]]Father's Legacy[[/b]] grows only as you prove worthy of the name: one point for each trial passed, sixteen in all, though some trials do not announce themselves.
[[b]]Father's Legacy[[/b]] is spent in the Legacy panel. Each doctrine costs one point and is permanent.
• Legacy is gained by completing certain missions.
• Legacy can be spent on different bonuses.
• These different bonuses increase stats of units.
• These bonuses come at the cost of the stats of your generals.
